# GitHub Self-Enforcement Infrastructure

## 핵심 원칙

> 설계서 1장이 GitHub layer에서 자동 강제됨. Orchestrator가 자리에 없어도 강제력 유지.

## 자동 변환 매핑

| 설계서 항목 | GitHub 인코딩 |
|-----------|--------------|
| `streams[X].scope_owns` | CODEOWNERS 항목 |
| `streams[X].blocked_by` | issue label `blocked-by:#N` + GitHub Action |
| `meta_files.owner` | CODEOWNERS (orchestrator only) |
| `work_declaration_protocol` | issue/PR template |
| `streams[X].phases[P].scope_owns` | scope_check.yml workflow |

## 산출물 (Phase 0 Step 4)

### .github/CODEOWNERS

```
# Auto-generated by orchestrator skill
# Source: docs/orchestrator/team_assignment.yaml
# Do not edit manually — run sync_design_to_github.py to update

# Stream S1 Foundation
docs/PRD.md             @{owner-S1}
docs/architecture.md    @{owner-S1}

# Stream S2 Frontend
frontend/**             @{owner-S2}

# ... per stream

# Meta files (orchestrator only)
CLAUDE.md               @{orchestrator-user}
MEMORY.md               @{orchestrator-user}
docs/orchestrator/**    @{orchestrator-user}
.github/**              @{orchestrator-user}
```

### .github/branch-protection.yml

```yaml
# Apply via: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection
required_pull_request_reviews:
  required_approving_review_count: 1
  dismiss_stale_reviews: true
  require_code_owner_reviews: true

required_status_checks:
  strict: true
  contexts:
    - scope_check
    - dependency_check
    - phase_gate_check

enforce_admins: false
allow_force_pushes: false
allow_deletions: false
required_linear_history: true
```

### .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/stream_work.yml

```yaml
name: Stream Work Declaration
description: Declare start of work in a Stream
labels: ["status:in-progress"]
body:
  - type: dropdown
    id: stream
    attributes:
      label: Stream
      options: [S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6]
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: scope
    attributes:
      label: Files in scope
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: deps
    attributes:
      label: Blocked by (other streams)
  - type: input
    id: eta
    attributes:
      label: Expected completion
```

### .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md

```markdown
## Stream
<!-- Auto-injected by team_session_start.py -->
Stream: SX
Phase: PX
Issue: #NNN

## Changes
<!-- summary of changes -->

## Scope Verification
- [ ] Changed files within `scope_owns`
- [ ] Meta files unchanged

## Meta Changes Requested (Optional)
<!-- If you need orchestrator to update CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, etc. -->
- N/A

## Dependencies
<!-- List blocked_by issues -->
Closes #NNN
```

### .github/workflows/scope_check.yml

```yaml
name: scope_check
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify scope
        run: |
          STREAM=$(echo "${{ github.head_ref }}" | grep -oP 'work/\K[^/]+')
          python tools/orchestrator/scope_verify.py --stream=$STREAM \
            --files="$(git diff --name-only origin/main..HEAD | tr '\n' ' ')"
```

### .github/workflows/dependency_check.yml

```yaml
name: dependency_check
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify dependencies
        run: |
          STREAM=$(echo "${{ github.head_ref }}" | grep -oP 'work/\K[^/]+')
          python tools/orchestrator/dependency_verify.py --stream=$STREAM
```

### .github/workflows/phase_gate_check.yml

```yaml
name: phase_gate_check
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Verify phase gate
        run: |
          STREAM=$(echo "${{ github.head_ref }}" | grep -oP 'work/\K[^/]+')
          python tools/orchestrator/phase_gate_validator.py --stream=$STREAM \
            --files="$(git diff --name-only origin/main..HEAD | tr '\n' ' ')"
```

## 실행 (sync_design_to_github.py)

```bash
python <project>/tools/orchestrator/sync_design_to_github.py
```

자동 수행:
1. team_assignment.yaml 로드
2. CODEOWNERS, branch-protection.yml, templates, workflows 렌더
3. .github/ 디렉토리에 작성
4. PR 생성 (label: orchestrator, auto-merge enabled)
5. branch protection 적용 (`gh api` 호출)

## 외부 권한 요구사항

- Repository owner 또는 admin 권한
- `gh` CLI 인증 완료 (`gh auth login`)
- branch protection 설정 권한

권한 부족 시 → 사용자 escalate (Phase 0 Step 8 한계 알림).
